label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: David Skinns leads RBC Canadian Open
items.text: David Skinns is 6-under today and 10-under overall through 15 holes, tied with Ben James at 10-under as the third round tightens at TPC Toronto at Osprey Valley.

items.headline: Nelly Korda shines at Dow Championship
items.text: Nelly Korda and Olivia Cowan shot a second-round 60 to reach 10-under and take the clubhouse lead after 36 holes in the Dow team event, the first team to hit double digits under par at Midland Country Club.

items.headline: PGA Tour schedule clouds Canadian Open future
items.text: With the PGA Tour’s two-track schedule looming, players like Nick Taylor express concern that the RBC Canadian Open may lose its 'Open' status if qualifying is replaced by a limited field.
